description: Coding standards and structure enforcement for Cherio monorepo (Next.js 16, Vite, Express, pnpm, Turbo).

rules.purpose: UI presentation only — JSX, props, markup, and event bindings.
constraints: No business logic or data fetching directly in JSX.
All logic must be extracted to corresponding `.hooks.ts` files.
All pure helper functions must live in `.utils.ts` files.
All strings must use i18n translations via `next-intl`.
Arabic locale must support RTL direction.

rules.purpose: Encapsulate business logic, async operations, and state management.
constraints: Hooks must remain pure, composable, and reusable.
Do not include JSX or styling here.
Use explicit TypeScript types for all params and returns.
All hooks must start with `use` prefix and be colocated with their component.
Utils must be stateless and side-effect free.
Avoid importing React or framework-specific code.
Prefer named exports and clear function names.
Never include DOM or UI references.
Use interfaces for shapes and type unions for constants.
No logic or imports from other layers.
Export types explicitly (no default export).

rules.purpose: Next.js 16 showcase app with i18n, SSR, and SEO metadata.
constraints: Use Server Components by default.
Use 'use client' only for interactive parts.
All text must come from next-intl messages (fr, en, ar).
Implement dir='rtl' for Arabic.
Use @/i18n/routing Link instead of Next.js Link.
Metadata must include alternates.languages for all locales.

rules.purpose: React + Vite frontend with Mantine UI.
constraints: Use Mantine components and theming only.
Use React Router v7 for routing.
Use Context or hooks for state, avoid prop drilling.
Split components following `.tsx` / `.hooks.ts` / `.utils.ts` pattern.
Use TypeScript and parameterized queries with pg.
Organize routes/controllers/middleware/models clearly.
Use JWT for auth (httpOnly cookies preferred).
Use bcrypt for password hashing.
Business logic lives only in controllers, never in routes.

rules.purpose: Shared TypeScript utilities and type definitions.
constraints: Keep dependencies minimal.
Export all through `src/index.ts`.
No framework-specific imports (React, Express, etc.).

testing.recommendation: Vitest or Jest depending on app
